name: Fairmont Mara Safari Club
positioning: Tented safari camp on the Mara River in the Olchoro Oirowua Conservancy, at the foot of the Aitong Hills
best_for: Travelers who want river views and wildlife from a private tent deck
Guests who want game drives and bush breakfasts in the Masai Mara

facts.text: The tented rooms are decorated in a fusion of traditional Maasai and heritage safari styles.
Riverfront tents have four-poster beds and en suite facilities.
Accommodations have Masai colors on the bedspreads and beaded curtains in the bathroom area.
In-room dining is available, with views of the Mara River.
Guests can join a beekeeping adventure and watch hippos from the hotel's deck.
The hotel offers holistic spa treatments.
Guests spot gazelles and lions along the banks of the Mara River.

highlights.text: Riverfront tents have private decks overlooking the river, with a view of the crocodiles and hippos below.
The hotel is set in the northwestern corner of the Maasai Mara, at the foot of the Aitong Hills in the Olchoro Oirowua Conservancy.
Meals at the boma, which is designed to resemble a Masai manyatta (village), are served both indoors and out.
Deluxe riverfront tents have decks with sunbeds and an outdoor shower.
The hotel offers sunrise and night game drives and a bush breakfast.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the remote location requires chartered flights or long drives from Nairobi.
WhataHotel notes wildlife viewing depends on migration patterns and weather conditions.
Accommodation is in tents rather than conventional hotel rooms.
